description:
Problem and scope decision
JidoChatBridge.capability_snapshot/1 returns only resolved support statuses. Unlike EmailBridge, it does not supply file_delivery metadata, so adapter facts cannot dynamically reach the shared BO settings and TransportRequirements resolver. The user explicitly requires this bridge path in PR 2. This brings bridge projection forward from zaq-h2i.4; that issue retains upstream adapter declarations/published dependency work.

Implementation and acceptance
- Inspect the actual Jido adapter contract and select the smallest explicit source for structured metadata. Document the source contract before implementation. The installed dependency has no established structured file-metadata API: do not pretend otherwise or add structured data to its status-only capability matrix.
- Dynamically project metadata from the selected adapter into the EXISTING capability_snapshot/1 result as optional file_delivery.
- Reuse CommunicationBridge.normalize_capability_snapshot/2 and ConnectorConfig.FileSettings. No duplicate normalization, provider-name cases, new endpoint, or parallel bridge file_delivery_capabilities callback.
- Preserve existing Jido/Mattermost native/fallback/unsupported meanings. Do not change Mattermost declarations, edit ignored deps, bump dependencies, or fabricate limits/transfer modes.
- Keep missing metadata safe and unresolved; invalid metadata follows the shared error contract. Generic message-edit support must not imply attachment-edit support.
- A contract-compatible test adapter supplying fixed/configurable/required limits, transfer mode and explicit attachment-edit support must drive the shared BO fields and TransportRequirements.resolve/2 without provider-specific consumer changes.
- Test the real snapshot boundary through Bridge, selected-adapter isolation, missing/malformed metadata, fixed ceiling enforcement and configuration precedence. Do not prove only a manually constructed map that bypasses JidoChatBridge.
- Keep channel policy/configuration separate from capability facts. Bridges must not construct TransportRequirements. Actual attachment sending remains outside PR 2.
Action reuse: extend JidoChatBridge.capability_snapshot/1; reuse Bridge.capability_snapshot/2, shared communication normalization, existing capability endpoint, FileSettings and TransportRequirements.resolve/2. No new Action or agent tool.
Read docs/action-reuse.md and docs/services/channels.md; inspect zaq-h2i.4 for the upstream dependency boundary. If a new upstream contract is required, record the precise proposal/prerequisite rather than hiding a speculative fallback.

Implementation prompt
Work on PR 2 in ../zaq-feat-channel-file-settings, branch feat/channel-file-settings (PR jat10/zaq#16, stacked on feat/email-capabilities). Verify current Git state and preserve other work. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Use Serena for source navigation. Implement with TDD: demonstrate the failure first, make the smallest coherent fix, then run focused regressions and mix q. Reuse existing test modules, fixtures and setup; create a test module only when no suitable owner exists, explaining why. Write original tests; do not copy tests from the old worktree or weaken existing assertions. Follow existing-test approval rules. Do not run mix precommit, commit, push or merge without fresh authorization.
title: [zaq-h2i.3] Project Jido adapter file metadata into shared capability settings
